description: Completed CSV-ACTOR-UNIT-ECONOMICS with verdict PURSUE_IF. Apify docs: profit = 0.8*revenue - platform costs, and free-plan users are excluded. At USD 0.005 per file, break-even is about 288 s billed per file at 256 MB, so volume is the risk, not margin. Set memory limits in actor.json (default 256 MB). Saved bilingual Store copy and a verified offline example output. Queued: update the NO-APIFY-ACCESS blocker, brief BUILDER on the launch conditions, record a lesson.
